title: The way in
starting_code: # The inner gate listens to a word. Then there are two sealed doors. Good luck!
hints: Take this one step at a time. First, use `move_up` to stand by the inner gate and `say` its password.
The password is the same as the great gate's. Then use `move_up` and `move_left` to reach the first sealed door.
Use `cast` to open the first door, move left to the second door, `cast` again, and move up to the road!
intro: This is it, the way out to the castle road! The inner gate listens to the same word as the great gate, and then there are two sealed doors. You can do this!
outro: We did it! We are on the castle road now. I am so glad we met!
